julesThoughtProcess: I chose a vibrant Spring Green (#00FA9A) to reflect the agricultural setting and the resilient organic life thriving within the steel and glass framework of the high-tech greenhouse.
storyPanel: Taking a quick breather in the upper canopy of the Sector 4 agricultural dome. The daily grind of recalibrating the climate scrubbers and tending to the engineered crops is physically demanding, and the occasional grid fluctuations don't make it any easier. But up here, surrounded by thriving greenery and catching up over a cup of hot synth-caf, the hard work pays off. They aren't just maintaining a facility; they are cultivating a small, vital piece of a better tomorrow.
